contenu:
resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/edge-api-proto

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: main-topic-in
spec:
  type: bindings.kafka
  metadata:
  - name: topics # Optional. in use for input bindings
    value:  main-topic
  - name: brokers
    value: localhost:9092
  - name: consumerGroup
    value: main-consumer
  # - name: publishTopic # Optional. in use for output bindings
  #   value: main-topic
  - name: authRequired # Required. default: "true"
    value: "false"
  - name: direction # Required. default: "true"
    value: "input"
  #  - name: saslUsername # Optional.
  #   value: "user"
  #  - name: saslPassword # Optional.
  #   value: "password"

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: main-topic-out
spec:
  type: bindings.kafka
  metadata:
  # - name: topics # Optional. in use for input bindings
  #   value: topic1,topic2
  - name: brokers
    value: localhost:9092
  # - name: consumerGroup
  #   value: group1
  - name: publishTopic # Optional. in use for output bindings
    value: main-topic
  - name: authRequired # Required. default: "true"
    value: "false"
  - name: direction # Required. default: "true"
    value: "output"
  #  - name: saslUsername # Optional.
  #   value: "user"
  #  - name: saslPassword # Optional.
  #   value: "password"

apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: mesx-secret-main
spec:
  type: secretstores.local.file
  version: v1
  metadata:
  - name: secretsFile
    value: "/home/chedy/mesx/mesx-proto-edge-api/daprComponents/secrets.json"
  - name: nestedSeparator
    value: ":"
  - name: multiValued
    value: "false"
